exceptions.rationale: Platform-blocked acceptance of Spring 5.3.39 on the javax-compatible Core/OMOD stack: no maintained open-source 5.3 release fixes it, OpenMRS Core 2.8.x and 2.9.x still pin 5.3.39, and the fix requires the unreleased Core 3.0 (Spring 7, Jakarta) plus migrated OMODs and Tomcat. Production use still requires explicit human review. Remove when a compatible Core release passes native, authentication and module tests; track migration in issue #323.
